stories.title: Austal Posts Record Revenue But a Loss; Michael Hill Reports a Turnaround
stories.summary: Austal posted record revenue for fiscal 2026. The company also reported a net loss, per its earnings call transcript. Michael Hill posted record revenue in the second half of fiscal 2026. Michael Hill calls this result a turnaround.
